mapper.select: select scheme_id as schemeId, dept_id as deptId, entry_year as entryYear, class_code as classCode, scheme_name as schemeName, scheme_version as schemeVersion, status, creator_user_id as creatorUserId, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from biz_class_group_scheme where dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode} and status='0' order by scheme_name, scheme_version desc

select scheme_id as schemeId, dept_id as deptId, entry_year as entryYear, class_code as classCode, scheme_name as schemeName, scheme_version as schemeVersion, status, creator_user_id as creatorUserId from biz_class_group_scheme where scheme_id=#{schemeId}

select group_id as groupId, scheme_id as schemeId, group_no as groupNo, group_name as groupName, color, sort_no as sortNo, leader_student_id as leaderStudentId from biz_class_group where scheme_id=#{schemeId} order by sort_no, group_no

select m.scheme_id as schemeId, m.group_id as groupId, m.student_id as studentId, m.sort_no as sortNo, u.nick_name as studentName, s.student_no as studentNo from biz_class_group_member m join biz_student s on s.student_id=m.student_id join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.user_id where m.scheme_id=#{schemeId} order by m.group_id,m.sort_no,cast(s.student_no as unsigned)
select count(1) from biz_teacher_class where user_id=#{userId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode}
select distinct dept_id from biz_teacher_class where user_id=#{userId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode} order by dept_id
select count(1) from biz_lesson_assignment where lesson_id=#{lessonId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode}

select s.student_id as studentId,s.student_no as studentNo,u.nick_name as studentName,u.user_id as userId from biz_student s join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.user_id and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' where u.dept_id=#{deptId} and s.entry_year=#{entryYear} and s.class_code=#{classCode} order by cast(s.student_no as unsigned),s.student_no
select coalesce(max(scheme_version), 0) + 1 from biz_class_group_scheme where dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode} and scheme_name=#{schemeName}

select snapshot_id as snapshotId, lesson_id as lessonId, dept_id as deptId, entry_year as entryYear, class_code as classCode, source_scheme_id as sourceSchemeId, source_scheme_version as sourceSchemeVersion, snapshot_hash as snapshotHash, frozen_time as frozenTime from biz_lesson_group_snapshot where lesson_id=#{lessonId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode}

select s.student_id as studentId,s.student_no as studentNo,u.nick_name as studentName,u.user_id as userId,s.remark as remark,g.group_id as groupId,g.group_no as groupNo,g.group_name as groupName,g.color as groupColor,g.leader_student_id as leaderStudentId,li.grid_row as gridRow,li.grid_col as gridCol,li.sort_no as sortNo from biz_student s join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.user_id and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' left join biz_class_group_member gm on gm.student_id=s.student_id and gm.scheme_id=(select x.scheme_id from biz_class_group_scheme x where x.dept_id=#{deptId} and x.entry_year=#{entryYear} and x.class_code=#{classCode} and x.status='0' order by x.create_time desc,x.scheme_id desc limit 1) left join biz_class_group g on g.group_id=gm.group_id left join biz_classroom_layout_item li on li.student_id=s.student_id and li.layout_id=#{layoutId} where u.dept_id=#{deptId} and s.entry_year=#{entryYear} and s.class_code=#{classCode} order by coalesce(li.sort_no,999999),cast(s.student_no as unsigned),s.student_no

SELECT a.student_id AS studentId, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'typing' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS typingAnsweredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'typing' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(a.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS typingScore, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'typing' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN a.typing_speed ELSE NULL END), 0) AS avgTypingSpeed, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'typing' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN a.accuracy_rate ELSE NULL END), 1) AS avgTypingAccuracy, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS theoryAnsweredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS theoryCorrectCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(a.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS theoryScore, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS practicalAnsweredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.submit_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS practicalSubmittedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS practicalScoredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' THEN IFNULL(a.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS practicalScore FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(answer_id) AS answer_id FROM biz_student_answer GROUP BY student_id, lesson_id, question_id ) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND lq.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND a.student_id IN #{studentId} GROUP BY a.student_id

select layout_id as layoutId,teacher_user_id as teacherUserId,dept_id as deptId,entry_year as entryYear,class_code as classCode,columns_count as columnsCount,layout_version as layoutVersion,update_time as updateTime from biz_classroom_layout where teacher_user_id=#{teacherUserId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and entry_year=#{entryYear} and class_code=#{classCode}
select layout_id as layoutId,student_id as studentId,grid_row as gridRow,grid_col as gridCol,sort_no as sortNo from biz_classroom_layout_item where layout_id=#{layoutId} order by sort_no
